BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to eminent domain; and adding a new section tochapter 8.25 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 8.25 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No private property shall be taken or damaged for public or privateuse that is to be transferred for use or possession by a governmentalagency of another state. In the event of conflict between theprovisions of this chapter and any other act, the provisions of thischapter shall govern.
